item.title: Artificial Intelligence and Social Media in B2B Markets: Transforming Relationships, Capabilities, and Value Creation
item.content:encoded:
This special issue in Industrial Marketing Management explores how artificial intelligence and social media are reshaping B2B marketing landscapes. The focus is on understanding the transformative impact of these technologies on business relationships, organizational capabilities, and the mechanisms through which value is created in B2B contexts.

item.title: Regional Industrial Marketing Management: Baltic States Summit
item.content:encoded:
This special issue focuses on industrial marketing management with a particular emphasis on the Baltic states region. The collection aims to advance understanding of how industrial marketing practices, strategies, and theories apply within the specific context of the Baltic economies and their integration into broader European markets.

Appel publié par Industrial Marketing Management. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.

Potential topics

  • Industrial marketing in the Baltic region
  • Regional market dynamics and strategies
  • B2B marketing approaches in emerging markets
  • International business relationships in Northern Europe
  • Sustainable industrial practices and marketing

Timeline

  • March 1, 2027: Full paper submission deadline
